content.title: Where To Watch UFC In 2026: How To Watch Every Fight
content.text: If you’re searching for where to watch UFC, or how to watch UFC in 2026, this guide breaks it all down. The main thing to know is that, as of this year, Paramount+ is the home of UFC – the place to watch live and on-demand UFC fights in the U.S. Additionally, select fights from select events air via simulcast on CBS. And the other thing to know: There is no pay-per-view. From every UFC numbered event to every UFC Fight Night to UFC at the White House, here’s exactly how to watch every UFC fight live and on demand this year. Let’s get you the Octagon® action. Get Started With Paramount+ When and where to watch UFC in 2026 In 2026, you can watch all 12 UFC numbered events, all 30 UFC Fight Nights, and UFC and the White House on Paramount+. Select UFC numbered events will be simulcast live on CBS, meaning you can catch that action on your TV or device by using cable, satellite, live-TV streaming service, or digital antenna. UFC event types and how to watch each one UFC numbered events Zuffa LLC via Getty Images A UFC numbered event is, literally, a numbered event, a la, UFC 324, UFC 325, UFC 326, UFC 327, and so on. It is UFC’s marquee event. Its fight card typically features one title bout – maybe more. There is about one UFC numbered event a month, and, indeed, in 2026, there will be 12 UFC numbered events streaming live and on demand on Paramount+, with select events airing via simulcast on CBS. Prior to 2026, if you wanted to watch a UFC numbered event, then you might’ve paid $79.99 for access. That’s because back then, and going back to UFC’s earliest years, UFC numbered events were pay-per-view. In the UFC on Paramount+ era, there is no pay-per-view. All UFC numbered events are included with the price of your regular monthly or annual Paramount+ subscription. UFC Fight Night Zuffa LLC via Getty Images UFC Fight Nights are near-weekly events that showcase rising contenders, tough-as-nails veterans, and local talents. In 2026, there will be 30 UFC Fight Nights. As with UFC numbered events, every UFC Fight Night streams live and on demand on Paramount+ with any Paramount+ subscription. There is no extra charge or fee to watch the action. UFC at the White House Zuffa LLC via Getty Images UFC Freedom 250: Topuria vs. Gaethje takes place Sunday, June 14, 2026, at the South Lawn of the White House. The historic, six-fight card, headlined by a lightweight title bout with champ Ilia Topuria going up against interim title holder Justin Gaethje, streams live and on demand in its entirety on Paramount+. Like all other UFC events, UFC at the White House is included with your regular Paramount+ subscription; there is no additional fee to access the event. Check out our UFC 2026 schedule, for a running list all announced upcoming UFC events, complete with start times (when available). UFC streaming FAQs for 2026 How can I watch without cable? You can watch UFC without cable by subscribing to Paramount+ (any plan), and streaming events live or on demand. Paramount+ plans start at $8.99 a month. Where can I watch fights live? UFC events stream live on Paramount+, with fights from select numbered events also airing live on CBS via simulcast. What devices can I use to watch UFC? When you have a Paramount+ subscription, and download the free Paramount+ app, you can watch UFC on smart TVs, mobile devices, tablets, desktop browsers, and supported streaming devices. What’s the best way to watch UFC online? Keeping or starting a Paramount+ subscription (any plan) is the way to watch UFC online in 2026. Paramount+ is the place to watch all UFC numbered events, all UFC Fight Nights, and UFC at the White House live and on demand. Your subscription also gets you access to the deep library of UFC fights on Paramount+, including every fight from every UFC numbered event of the 2020s. Do I need ESPN+ to watch UFC PPVs? That’s a no — and no. In 2026, UFC events stream live and on demand on Paramount+ with your regular Paramount+ subscription. There are no UFC events on ESPN+ or ESPN. And in the U.S., there is no UFC pay-per-view. Can I stream events on mobile? Yes. When you have a Paramount+ subscription, and download the Paramount+ app, you can stream UFC events on mobile. Paramount+ supports mobile streaming on supported smartphones and tablets. How can I watch replays? You can watch UFC replays on Paramount+ shortly after each live fight ends. Every fight from every UFC numbered event and every UFC Fight Night streams on demand. UFC on Paramount+ Watch Now
